example.title: Shaker Church Family Round Barn (HABS MA-674)

brief: Great round stone dairy barn about 90 ft across, its drum of grey split-face fieldstone laid in rough courses with stone-arched wagon doorways and plank doors, small six-pane windows and a bank ramp to the upper level on one side. The low conical roof rises to a white-painted clapboard clerestory ring with a band of small windows (rebuilt 1864 after a fire), topped by a second smaller drum and a lantern cupola with a weather vane. Inside, stalls ring a central timber hay mow. Long gable-roofed board-sided cow sheds on posts join it to one side, with a wooden twin-stave silo tower beyond. (Conical roof; nearest vocabulary roof type is pyramid.)
